text: 您好，我有严重的食物过敏。
back_translation: Hello, I have a severe food allergy.

text: 点餐前，请您仔细阅读这张卡片。
back_translation: Before ordering, please read this card carefully.

text: 我对以下食物过敏：
back_translation: I am allergic to the following foods:

text: 我的过敏很严重。即使只吃极少量，也可能让我病得很严重。
back_translation: My allergy is very severe. Even eating only an extremely small amount can make me very seriously ill.

text: 这种过敏可能危及生命。
back_translation: This allergy may endanger my life.

text: 我有食物不耐受。虽然不会危及生命，但会让我非常难受。
back_translation: I have a food intolerance. Although it is not life-threatening, it makes me feel very unwell.

text: 这是身体疾病，不是个人口味偏好。
back_translation: This is a bodily illness, not a personal taste preference.

text: 谢谢您在准备我的餐食时格外用心。
back_translation: Thank you for taking extra care when preparing my meal.

text: 花生
back_translation: Peanuts

text: 所有坚果，例如杏仁（巴旦木）、核桃、腰果和榛子
back_translation: All nuts, for example almonds / apricot kernels (badam almond), walnuts, cashews and hazelnuts

text: 杏仁（巴旦木）
back_translation: Almond / apricot kernel (badam almond)

text: 榛子
back_translation: Hazelnut

text: 核桃
back_translation: Walnut

text: 腰果
back_translation: Cashew

text: 碧根果（美国山核桃）
back_translation: Pecan (American hickory nut)

text: 巴西坚果
back_translation: Brazil nut

text: 开心果
back_translation: Pistachio

text: 夏威夷果（澳洲坚果）
back_translation: Macadamia ("Hawaii nut" / Australian nut)

text: 牛奶及所有乳制品
back_translation: Cow's milk and all dairy products

text: 蛋类（包括鸡蛋）
back_translation: Eggs (including chicken eggs)

text: 鱼类
back_translation: Fish

text: 甲壳类海鲜，例如小虾、大虾、螃蟹和龙虾
back_translation: Crustacean seafood, for example small shrimp, large prawns, crabs and lobsters

text: 贝类及软体类海鲜，例如青口（贻贝）、蛤蜊、生蚝（牡蛎）、鱿鱼和章鱼
back_translation: Shellfish / bivalves and mollusc seafood, for example mussels, clams, oysters, squid and octopus

text: 大豆（黄豆）
back_translation: Soybeans (yellow soybeans)

text: 麸质（包括小麦、大麦、黑麦，以及未经无麸质认证的燕麦）
back_translation: Gluten (including wheat, barley, rye, and oats not certified gluten-free)

text: 小麦
back_translation: Wheat

text: 芝麻
back_translation: Sesame

text: 芥末（芥菜籽及其制品，如黄芥末酱、芥末粉、芥末油）
back_translation: Mustard (mustard seed and products made from it, such as yellow mustard sauce, mustard powder, mustard oil)

text: 芹菜（包括根芹和芹菜盐）
back_translation: Celery (including celeriac and celery salt)

text: 羽扇豆粉和羽扇豆籽
back_translation: Lupin flour and lupin seeds

text: 亚硫酸盐
back_translation: Sulphites

text: 松子
back_translation: Pine nuts

text: 椰子
back_translation: Coconut

text: 荞麦
back_translation: Buckwheat

text: 玉米
back_translation: Corn / maize

text: 豆类，例如小扁豆、鹰嘴豆和豌豆
back_translation: Beans / legumes, for example lentils, chickpeas and peas

text: 猕猴桃（奇异果）
back_translation: Kiwi fruit (macaque peach / "strange fruit")

text: 红肉（哺乳动物的肉）及哺乳动物来源的明胶（α-半乳糖过敏）
back_translation: Red meat (meat of mammals) and gelatin of mammalian origin (alpha-gal allergy)

text: 桃子及其他核果类水果，例如李子、杏和樱桃
back_translation: Peaches and other stone fruits, for example plums, apricots and cherries

text: 苹果
back_translation: Apple

text: 香蕉
back_translation: Banana

text: 芒果
back_translation: Mango

text: 番茄（西红柿）
back_translation: Tomato

text: 大蒜
back_translation: Garlic

text: 洋葱，包括葱（小葱）和红葱头
back_translation: Onion, including scallions / spring onions (small green onions) and shallots

text: 鸡肉，包括鸡汤和鸡精（鸡粉）
back_translation: Chicken meat, including chicken soup/broth and chicken essence (chicken bouillon powder)

text: 猪肉，包括猪油和猪肉高汤
back_translation: Pork, including lard and pork stock

text: 明胶（吉利丁）
back_translation: Gelatin (gelatine)

text: 味精（谷氨酸钠）
back_translation: MSG (monosodium glutamate)

text: 这也包括用它制成的任何油、酱汁、酱、粉、粉末、黄油或抹酱，以及装饰配料。
back_translation: This also includes any oil, sauce, paste, flour / rice noodles (粉), powder, butter or spread made from it, as well as garnishes/decorative toppings.

text: 请确认是否用了花生油，包括油炸时用的油。
back_translation: Please confirm whether peanut oil was used, including the oil used for deep-frying.

text: 请确认沙爹酱、青酱（罗勒松子酱）、墨西哥摩尔酱和果仁糖等酱料。
back_translation: Please check sauces such as satay sauce, pesto (basil pine-nut sauce), Mexican mole sauce and praline (nut candy).

text: 请确认甜点中是否有杏仁膏、牛轧糖或杏仁粉（巴旦木粉）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether desserts contain marzipan (almond paste), nougat or almond flour (badam / sweet almond flour).

text: 请确认是否用了鱼露或凤尾鱼（鳀鱼），包括在沙拉汁里。
back_translation: Please confirm whether fish sauce or anchovies were used, including in salad dressing.

text: 请确认是否用了蚝油或XO酱。
back_translation: Please confirm whether oyster sauce or XO sauce was used.

text: 请确认是否用了虾酱或干虾（虾米、虾皮）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether shrimp paste or dried shrimp (dried shrimp, tiny dried shrimp) were used.

text: 请确认是否用了鱼高汤（例如日式高汤或木鱼花）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether fish stock (for example Japanese dashi or bonito flakes) was used.

text: 请确认是否用了酱油，酱油里也含有小麦。
back_translation: Please confirm whether soy sauce was used; soy sauce also contains wheat.

text: 请确认是否用了味噌、豆腐或豆酱。
back_translation: Please confirm whether miso, tofu or bean paste was used.

text: 请确认是否用了海鲜酱、豆豉酱或其他豆类酱料。
back_translation: Please confirm whether hoisin sauce (literally 'seafood sauce'), fermented black bean sauce or other bean sauces were used.

text: 请确认是否用了芝麻油（香油）、芝麻酱，或在菜上撒了芝麻。
back_translation: Please confirm whether sesame oil (fragrant oil), sesame paste was used, or sesame seeds were sprinkled on the dish.

text: 请确认烹饪时是否用了黄油、酥油、奶油或奶酪。
back_translation: Please confirm whether butter, ghee, cream / butter (奶油) or cheese was used in cooking.

text: 请确认是否含有奶粉、乳清或酪蛋白。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains milk powder, whey or casein.

text: 请确认面包或酥皮表面是否刷了蛋液，以及面糊里是否加了鸡蛋。
back_translation: Please confirm whether the surface of bread or pastry was brushed with egg wash, and whether egg was added to the batter.

text: 请确认是否含有蛋黄酱（美乃滋）和蒜泥蛋黄酱。
back_translation: Please confirm whether it contains mayonnaise and garlic mayonnaise (aioli).

text: 请确认是否用面粉给酱汁增稠，或给食物裹粉。
back_translation: Please confirm whether flour was used to thicken sauces or to coat food.

text: 请确认所用的高汤、汤底和各种调味粉。
back_translation: Please check the stocks, soup bases and various seasoning powders used.

text: 请确认是否用了伍斯特酱（辣酱油），它含有凤尾鱼。
back_translation: Please confirm whether Worcestershire sauce ('spicy soy sauce') was used; it contains anchovies.

text: 请确认是否用了葡萄酒、醋或果干（含亚硫酸盐）。
back_translation: Please confirm whether wine, vinegar or dried fruit (contain sulphites) were used.

text: 即使是共用厨具上沾到的微量残留，也可能引起过敏反应。
back_translation: Even trace residue picked up from shared kitchen utensils can cause an allergic reaction.

text: 请不要使用炸过我过敏食物的油或油炸锅。
back_translation: Please do not use oil or a fryer that has been used to fry foods I am allergic to.

text: 请使用干净的锅、炒锅和厨具。
back_translation: Please use clean pots/pans, woks and utensils.

text: 请使用干净的菜板和刀。
back_translation: Please use a clean cutting board and knife.

text: 请不要在共用的烤架或铁板上烹饪我的食物。
back_translation: Please do not cook my food on a shared grill or griddle (iron plate).

text: 准备我的食物前，请先洗手并更换手套。
back_translation: Before preparing my food, please first wash your hands and change gloves.

text: 请不要添加任何我没有确认过的装饰配料、浇头或酱汁。
back_translation: Please do not add any garnishes, toppings or sauces that I have not confirmed.

text: 请单独制作并单独上我的菜。
back_translation: Please prepare my dish separately and serve it separately.

text: 从已经做好的菜里挑出过敏食物是不安全的。请重新做一份。
back_translation: Picking the allergen food out of an already-made dish is not safe. Please make a new one.

text: 自助餐的取菜勺是共用的，所以我不能吃自助餐。
back_translation: Buffet serving spoons are shared, so I cannot eat from the buffet.

text: 面包店对我来说通常不安全，因为空气中和台面上常有面粉和坚果。
back_translation: Bakeries are usually not safe for me, because there is often flour and nuts in the air and on the counters.

text: 这道菜含有我过敏的任何食物吗？
back_translation: Does this dish contain any of the foods I am allergic to?

text: 您能和厨师确认一下配料吗？
back_translation: Could you confirm the ingredients with the chef?

text: 我可以看看配料的标签或包装吗？
back_translation: May I see the ingredient label or packaging?

text: 这道菜是不是和其他食物用同一锅油做的？
back_translation: Is this dish made in the same pot of oil as other foods?

text: 这道菜是不是和其他食物用同一个锅或炒锅做的？
back_translation: Is this dish made in the same pot/pan or wok as other foods?

text: 酱汁里有什么？
back_translation: What is in the sauce?

text: 肉或鱼腌过吗？腌料里有什么？
back_translation: Was the meat or fish marinated? What is in the marinade?

text: 沙拉汁（调味汁）里有什么？
back_translation: What is in the salad dressing (dressing)?

text: 甜点里含有坚果、牛奶或鸡蛋吗？
back_translation: Does the dessert contain nuts, milk or eggs?

text: 面包里含有牛奶、鸡蛋、坚果或籽类吗？
back_translation: Does the bread contain milk, eggs, nuts or seeds?

text: 这个汤用的是什么高汤？
back_translation: What stock is used for this soup?

text: 这是厨房现做的，还是买来的成品？
back_translation: Is this made fresh in the kitchen, or is it a bought ready-made product?

text: 哪些菜你们可以安全地为我做？
back_translation: Which dishes can you safely make for me?

text: 这道菜能不能从头新做，不放我过敏的食物？
back_translation: Can this dish be made fresh from scratch, without the foods I am allergic to?

text: 厨师有把握这道菜对我是安全的吗？
back_translation: Is the chef confident this dish is safe for me?

text: 有没有哪种配料标注了“可能含有”我过敏的食物？
back_translation: Are any ingredients labelled "may contain" the foods I am allergic to?

text: 厨房里会用坚果或花生吗？
back_translation: Does the kitchen use nuts or peanuts?

text: 油炸食品是用共用的油炸的吗？
back_translation: Are fried foods fried in shared oil?

text: 是
back_translation: Yes

text: 否
back_translation: No

text: 我不确定
back_translation: I am not sure

text: 我去问一下厨师
back_translation: I will go ask the chef

text: 可以，我们能安全地做
back_translation: Yes, we can make it safely

text: 不行，我们无法安全地做
back_translation: No, we cannot make it safely

text: 这里面含有您过敏的食物
back_translation: This contains a food you are allergic to

text: 可能含有微量过敏原
back_translation: May contain traces of allergens

text: 我拿标签给您看
back_translation: I will bring the label to show you

text: 我推荐这道菜
back_translation: I recommend this dish

text: 请点选您的回答。
back_translation: Please tap to select your answer.

text: 您能推荐一道我可以安全食用的菜吗？
back_translation: Could you recommend a dish I can safely eat?

text: 简单的就可以，比如不加调料的烤肉或烤鱼，配米饭或蔬菜。
back_translation: Something simple is fine, for example grilled/roasted meat or fish without seasoning, with rice or vegetables.

text: 请不要加酱汁。
back_translation: Please do not add sauce.

text: 请只用盐、胡椒和橄榄油来烹饪。
back_translation: Please cook it using only salt, pepper and olive oil.

text: 您能把配料写下来给我吗？
back_translation: Could you write down the ingredients for me?

text: 如果您不确定，请告诉我。我宁可不点，也不想冒险。
back_translation: If you are not sure, please tell me. I would rather not order than take a risk.

text: 请务必确保端给我的就是这道菜。
back_translation: Please be sure that what is brought to me is exactly this dish.

text: 上菜时，请跟我确认这就是为我的过敏专门准备的那道菜。
back_translation: When serving, please confirm with me that this is the dish specially prepared for my allergy.

text: 我只要一杯饮料就好，谢谢。
back_translation: I'll just have a drink, thank you.

text: 我可以看一下过敏原信息或过敏原菜单吗？
back_translation: May I see the allergen information or an allergen menu?

text: 我可以吃自己带来的食物吗？
back_translation: May I eat food that I brought myself?

text: 非常感谢您的帮助。
back_translation: Thank you very much for your help.

text: 我正在发生过敏反应。
back_translation: I am having an allergic reaction right now.

text: 请马上叫救护车。
back_translation: Please call an ambulance immediately.

text: 请告诉他们：“严重过敏反应（过敏性休克）”。
back_translation: Please tell them: "severe allergic reaction (anaphylactic shock)".

text: 我包里有一支肾上腺素自动注射笔。
back_translation: I have an adrenaline (epinephrine) auto-injector pen in my bag.

text: 请帮我使用它。
back_translation: Please help me use it.

text: 注射在大腿外侧，可以隔着衣服打。
back_translation: Inject into the outer thigh; it can be given through clothing.

text: 请帮我躺下。不要让我站起来或走动。
back_translation: Please help me lie down. Do not let me stand up or walk around.

text: 如果我呼吸困难，请扶我坐起来。
back_translation: If I have difficulty breathing, please help me sit up.

text: 如果5分钟后仍没有好转，可以使用第二支自动注射笔。
back_translation: If there is still no improvement after 5 minutes, a second auto-injector pen can be used.

text: 请陪着我，直到救援人员到达。
back_translation: Please stay with me until rescue personnel arrive.

text: 最近的有急诊科的医院在哪里？
back_translation: Where is the nearest hospital with an emergency department?

text: 最近的药店在哪里？
back_translation: Where is the nearest pharmacy?

text: 您有抗组胺药片吗？
back_translation: Do you have antihistamine tablets?

text: 请帮我打电话给我的紧急联系人。
back_translation: Please help me phone my emergency contact.

text: 这个产品含有我过敏的任何成分吗？
back_translation: Does this product contain any ingredient I am allergic to?

text: 您能帮我读一下这个标签吗？
back_translation: Could you help me read this label?

text: 标签上有没有写“可能含有微量”？
back_translation: Does the label say "may contain traces"?

text: 有没有不含我过敏成分的牌子？
back_translation: Is there a brand that does not contain the ingredients I am allergic to?

text: 你们卖不含过敏原的产品吗？
back_translation: Do you sell allergen-free products?

text: 你们卖无麸质的面包或意大利面吗？
back_translation: Do you sell gluten-free bread or pasta?

text: 你们卖不含坚果或大豆的植物奶吗？
back_translation: Do you sell plant milks that do not contain nuts or soy?

text: 请把我的过敏情况告知早餐工作人员。
back_translation: Please inform the breakfast staff of my allergy.

text: 厨房能为我准备一份安全的餐食吗？
back_translation: Can the kitchen prepare a safe meal for me?

text: 我有严重过敏。请不要给我任何我没有确认过的餐食。
back_translation: I have a severe allergy. Please do not give me any meal I have not confirmed.

text: 您能请附近的乘客不要吃坚果或花生吗？
back_translation: Could you ask nearby passengers not to eat nuts or peanuts?

text: 我必须时刻随身携带我的过敏药物。
back_translation: I must carry my allergy medication with me at all times.

text: 我有医生开具的用药证明信。
back_translation: I have a medication certificate letter issued by a doctor.
